name: board
description: Scripts only: the board has no runtime dependencies and no build step. TypeScript only checks the JSDoc.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js tools/*.js tools/*/*.js; do node --experimental-default-type=module --check "$f" || { echo "FAIL $f"; exit 1; }; done && node tools/check-imports.js && node tools/check-merge.js && node tools/check-board-tasks.js && node tools/check-linkedin.js && node tools/check-app-version.js && bun run typecheck
